Class HeatmapRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.HeatmapRenderer
public class HeatmapRenderer extends Object
Thematic Layer Renderer for continuous demographic, thermodynamic, hydrologic, and macroeconomic heatmaps.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to decouple the core canvas rendering loop and camera projection from thematic domain coloring, ensuring modularity, high maintainability, and clean SRP.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
